summary: Iter81 Phase 5 — Progression-aware Marathon adjustments. Backend-only verification. Ran /app/backend/tests/test_iter81_phase5_progression_scaling.py (reference suite): 14/14 PASS covering (a) PROGRESSION_SCALARS dict has all 4 statuses with correct directionality: progressing_well=1.07 > maintain=1.00 > reduce_load=0.88 > deload=0.55; (b) PROGRESSION_REASONS has non-empty string for all 4 statuses; (c) scale_endurance_session no-op with None; (d) maintain stamps progression_status only, no numeric change; (e) progressing_well: 75→80 min, reps '60-90 min steady'→'64-96 min', change_reason=PROGRESSION_REASONS[progressing_well]; (f) reduce_load: 75→65 min, reps '53-79 min'; (g) deload: 75→40 min, reps ~'33-49 min'; (h) existing change_reason is preserved and appended with ' · ' delimiter; (i) duration=20 at deload floors to 15; (j) non-endurance strength_support reps '10' unchanged; (k+l) build_template_plan(marathon user, 7 home days) integration: baseline vs reduce_load → Long Run duration shorter + progression_status + change_reason stamped; baseline vs progressing_well → Long Run duration longer + progression_status stamped; (m) get_current_status returns valid status when snapshot exists. Also authored and ran new HTTP-flow suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter81_phase5_phase5_http_flow.py: 2 PASS, 1 SKIP. PASS: POST /api/progress/recompute returns 200 with valid snapshot {status='reduce_load', status_label='PULL BACK', reason=..., coach_note=..., metrics=..., week_start, week_end} for client@crewfit.com; latest snapshot readable. SKIP: the end-to-end regenerate propagation test — the seeded client@crewfit.com does not have a marathon/endurance profile (roster iter74-7c629f4e produced only focus=full/mobility workouts), so scale_endurance_session has nothing to touch, and progression_status is (correctly) not stamped on non-endurance sessions. The propagation path itself is fully covered by the two build_template_plan integration tests in the reference file. Verified all 5 callsites in the codebase pass progression_status kwarg: server.py:3042/3349, feature_roster_confirmation.py:390, feature_programme_quality.py:875, feature_coach_workout_editor.py:539.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_progression.scale_endurance_session correctly guards with `if not scalar or abs(scalar - 1.0) < 0.02` so maintain and unknown statuses stamp progression_status but skip numeric mutation — matches spec.
Regex `_re.sub(r"(\d+)-(\d+)\s+(min[a-z ]*)", ...)` scales range strings; `_re.sub(r"^(\d+)\s+(min[a-z ]*)", ...)` handles single '30 min' patterns. Both operate on `reps` field only.
duration_min floor at 15 (`max(15, ...)`) matches the min-duration spec (20 → 15 at deload).
change_reason is appended (not overwritten) when a hotel/eq gate reason already exists — coach visibility preserved. Delimiter '  · ' (two spaces + middot).
PROGRESSION_SCALARS values: progressing_well=1.07 (+7%), maintain=1.00, reduce_load=0.88 (-12%), deload=0.55 (-45%) — matches spec exactly.
All 5 downstream callsites correctly await get_current_status(db, user_id) before calling build_template_plan(...), progression_status=prog_status).
Non-endurance sessions (reps='10') pass through unchanged — pattern anchored to 'min' unit.
Baseline vs progression comparison in build_template_plan asserts direction (< / >), not exact numbers — insulates against future baseline tweaks.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 is production-ready. All 14 reference tests + 2 HTTP tests pass. The single skipped HTTP test (test_regenerated_workouts_carry_progression_status) requires a MARATHON client with an active roster to observe end-to-end propagation of progression_status onto endurance workouts. If you want to force that path in a future iteration: PATCH /api/user/profile with {main_goal_key:'event', event_type_pref:'marathon', training_days_per_week:5} against a fresh client, run /api/progress/recompute, then trigger /api/workouts/regenerate — but this permanently changes the seed client's profile so beware of downstream impact on iter84 (client dashboard) tests. Otherwise, the two build_template_plan integration tests inside test_iter81_phase5_progression_scaling.py already exercise the exact marathon path in-process.
